scenes.name: NO RULER
lines: Most physics starts with a ruler: a zero mark, an outside frame, a point called the origin.
大多数物理从一把尺子开始：一个零刻度，一个外面的坐标架，一个叫作原点的点。
But who handed us that zero? Take the ruler away, and keep only comparisons.
可是，谁把这个零交给了我们？把尺子拿走，只留下比较。
Two moves are left. The first carries the step from y to x over onto z.
只剩两个动作。第一个：把从 y 到 x 的那一步，原样搬到 z 上。
The second reads how alike two points are: one means identical, zero means fully mismatched.
第二个：读出两点有多像；1 表示同一个点，0 表示完全失配。
The rules are plain: a step from a point to itself does nothing, and carrying never changes a reading.
规则很朴素：从自己到自己的一步什么也不做，搬运也从不改变读数。

scenes.name: FIVE COLUMNS
lines: One structure obeys every rule: the unit quaternions, read as one plus their dot product, over two.
有一个结构守住全部规则：单位四元数，读数取“一加点积，再除以二”。
Take five of them: one, minus one, i, j and k. Their readings fill a table of ones, halves, and just two zeros.
取其中五个：1、−1、i、j、k。读数表里是 1、一半，还有仅有的两个 0。
Its determinant is one eighth, not zero. So these readings need five columns; four will never do.
这张表的行列式是八分之一，不是零：这些读数要五栏才写得下，四栏永远不够。
Lean checks the general fact: any structure where order matters, linked by small steps, needs at least five.
Lean 内核检验了一般事实：任何讲究先后、又能一小步一小步连通的结构，都至少要五栏。

scenes.name: FIVE MEANS QUATERNIONS
lines: Now ask for exactly five columns, a reading that gets down to zero, and no gaps in the limit.
现在要求：恰好五栏，读数能降到零，取极限时没有缺口。
Lean checks the answer: the structure is the unit quaternions, point for point, moves and readings alike.
Lean 内核检验了答案：这个结构就是单位四元数，一点对一点，动作和读数都对得上。
And any point you like can be sent to one. The origin was never out there; we only chose it.
而且你挑哪个点，就能把哪个点送到 1。原点从来不在外面，只是我们选的。

scenes.name: TWO SHADOWS
lines: Quantum physics ignores an overall phase. So slide one point around its phase circle.
量子物理不理会整体相位。那就让一个点沿着它的相位圆滑动。
Read it twice, a quarter turn apart, square both readings, and add them.
读两次，相隔四分之一圈，两个读数各自平方，再相加。
Like a clock hand seen by two shadows: the shadows trade as it turns, but the sum stays zero point three six.
像隔着两道影子看一根钟表指针：指针转，两道影子此消彼长，平方和始终是 0.36。
Lean checks that this sum ignores the phase and equals the Born weight, the squared overlap of two spinors.
Lean 内核检验：这个和不理会相位，并且等于玻恩权重，即两个旋量重叠的模平方。

scenes.name: SAME READING, SAME PAIR
lines: On a perfect ball no spot is special: two pins at one distance look like any other two.
在完美的球上，没有哪一处特殊：隔着同样距离的两枚图钉，和任何另一对看起来都一样。
These two pairs share the reading zero point eight, so their quotients share a real part, zero point six.
这两对点的读数都是 0.8，所以它们的商有相同的实部：0.6。
What is left is an arrow of length zero point eight, and one turn lays one arrow on the other.
剩下的是一支长 0.8 的箭头；转一下，就能把这一支叠到另一支上。
Lean checks it for every pair: with equal readings, one multiplication on each side carries one pair onto the other.
Lean 内核检验：对任意两对点，读数相同，就有左右各乘一次，把一对送到另一对。

scenes.name: WHAT IT DOES NOT SAY
lines: Drop the no-gaps rule, and the rational quaternions pass every other test, yet leave holes everywhere.
去掉“没有缺口”这一条，有理四元数能通过其余每一关，却处处留洞。
The rules themselves are a model. Calling the Born weight a probability is a reading, not a proof.
这套规则本身是一个模型；把玻恩权重叫作概率，是一种读法，不是证明。
Asking for the fewest columns is our choice. The theorems say what follows from it, nothing more.
要求栏数最少，是我们的选择；定理说的是由此推出什么，仅此而已。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Geometric Intuition of Quantum Computing, chapter thirty-nine.
《量子计算的几何直觉》· 第三十九章
